en.description: Mzansi Stream offers prepaid internet TV for South African viewers. Check the programmes available in your country and the picture on your device during the free 24-hour trial. You can request the trial and contact support on WhatsApp.
en.productDescription: Mzansi Stream IPTV subscription, term: {name}. Live channels and on-demand titles as described on the site, ordered via WhatsApp.
en.compareHook: DStv Stream Starter is quoted in South African rand. The prepaid day pass costs USD 5, one month costs USD 15 and one year costs USD 65.

faq.q: How much does Mzansi Stream cost?
faq.a: The prepaid day pass costs USD 5, one month costs USD 15 and one year costs USD 65. The 24-hour trial can be requested separately before payment.

faq.q: How does the free 24 hour trial work?
faq.a: Send a WhatsApp message with your device and the country where you will watch. Ask for a free 24-hour trial. A card is not required. Use your normal internet connection and check the programmes that matter to you before choosing a paid term.

faq.q: Is IPTV legal in South Africa?
faq.a: The site's guide is not legal advice and makes no legality claim; it says redistributing copyrighted channels without permission is a copyright question. This site does not publish a licence schedule and does not state that Mzansi Stream holds broadcast or redistribution licences. The full written guide is the page Is IPTV legal in South Africa.

faq.q: Which devices does Mzansi Stream work on?
faq.a: The homepage lists Smart TVs from Samsung, LG and Sony, plus Firestick and Fire TV, Android TV, iPhone, iPad, Android phones, an Android TV box, MAG Box, and PC or Mac. An M3U link is sent on WhatsApp for TiviMate, IPTV Smarters Pro, GSE Smart IPTV or any standard M3U player. Install help is offered for the device you name.

faq.q: Can I watch SuperSport without a DStv decoder?
faq.a: Start with the competition, match date and country where you will watch. The local broadcaster can vary by event. Use the SuperSport viewing guide to find the official broadcaster, then check its live schedule and package. Mzansi’s trial lets you test the service on your own device.

faq.q: How fast is activation and is the programme guide included?
faq.a: Ask for setup help on WhatsApp and name your device. The team can confirm the current waiting time. A free trial can be requested before payment. Paid plans include an electronic programme guide. Share your TV brand and model so support can send the right setup instructions.

faq.q: How do I pay and is there a contract?
faq.a: Payment is handled on WhatsApp. The site lists EFT, SnapScan, Zapper, Yoco, Ozow, Capitec Pay, Visa, Mastercard, PayPal and Bitcoin. The 24 hour trial does not need a credit card. There is no contract and no automatic renewal. You pay once and the service ends when the period you chose ends, then you renew manually if you want.

faq.q: Does Mzansi Stream work on SA fibre and outside South Africa?
faq.a: Check the programme in the country where you will use the service. Availability changes by territory. For a sports fixture, check the local broadcaster’s schedule. A trial on your home Wi-Fi helps you check picture quality on your own television before you pay.

faq.q: Can several people watch at once and what if a stream fails?
faq.a: The standard plan includes one connection. If you need more than one screen at the same time, the site says to message WhatsApp for a tailored plan. If a stream fails, you message WhatsApp; the site treats outages as a support job and publishes no fix time.

faq.q: Are Springboks rugby and Proteas cricket included?
faq.a: The broadcaster for a rugby Test, league match or cricket series depends on the competition and your country. Find the event in the local broadcaster’s schedule. Match coverage and replay windows are separate, so check both if you plan to watch later.
